log_file.description: Path to the agent log file

log_date_format.description: Date/time format used in log entries

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in MiB) per log file before rotation

log_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain

ovsdb_socket.description: Path to the OVSDB management socket

bgp_speaker_type.description: BGP implementation to use; choose from 'go-bgp', 'frr', 'bird'

bgp_as.description: Local autonomous system number for BGP

bgp_router_id.description: BGP router ID (IPv4 address); set to 'auto' to auto-detect

bgp_hold_time.description: BGP hold timer in seconds (must be ≥ 3)

bgp_keepalive_interval.description: BGP keepalive interval in seconds (recommended: 1/3 hold_time)

route_advertise_delay.description: Seconds to wait before advertising routes after BGP session establishment

advertise_node_local_ip.description: Advertise local node tunnel IPs (e.g., geneve/vxlan IPs) to BGP peers

advertise_external_ip.description: Advertise external/subnet gateway IPs to BGP peers

bgp_neighbors.description: List of BGP peers (neighbors) to connect to

sr_iov_enabled.description: Enable advertisement of SR-IOV VF port IPs

sr_iov_pci_addresses.description: List of PCI addresses (e.g., 0000:03:00.1) for SR-IOV VFs to include

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate for secure DB connections (TLS)

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate for DB TLS

ssl_key_file.description: Path to client private key for DB TLS

ovs_bridge.description: Name of the OVS bridge to use for external port IP discovery

snmp_enabled.description: Enable SNMP monitoring for BGP session metrics

snmp_listen.description: IP address and port to bind SNMP agent (e.g., 127.0.0.1:16100)

snmp_community.description: SNMP v2c/v1 read community string (insecure in production)

metrics_port.description: Port to expose BGP metrics (e.g., for Prometheus scraping); set to 0 to disable

healthcheck_enabled.description: Enable lightweight HTTP health check endpoint at port 8081

removed.description: log_date_format was missing from template, added; log_format was missing from template and schema, added; log_date_format default was fixed to match documentation.
